name: Açaí Berry
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in SIBO patients when consumed in normal serving sizes as açaí is naturally low FODMAP.
preparationTips: Use frozen açaí pulp rather than sweetened açaí products which may contain high FODMAP sweeteners
Blend with low FODMAP fruits like strawberries or kiwi for smoothie bowls
Check açaí powder labels for added inulin or high FODMAP ingredients
Start with smaller portions if you have sensitive digestion
